faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GMC Gondia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GMC Gondia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 17 vacancies: 3 Assistant Professor (Anatomy), 1 Assistant Professor (Physiology), 2 Assistant Professor (Biochemistry), 2 Assistant Professor (Pharmacology), 2 Assistant Professor (Pathology), 1 Assistant Professor (Microbiology) and 4 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GMC Gondia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application form on www.gmcgondya.in and www.med-edu.in) and send it to Office of Government Medical College, Gondia, Kunwar Tilaksingh General Hospital Campus, Nehru Chowk, Gondia, Maharashtra, by by hand, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Assistant Professor (Anatomy): up to 40 years for open category, up to 45 years for backward category; Assistant Professor (Physiology): up to 40 years for open category, up to 45 years for backward category; Assistant Professor (Biochemistry): up to 40 years for open category, up to 45 years for backward category; Assistant Professor (Pharmacology): up to 40 years for open category, up to 45 years for backward category; Assistant Professor (Pathology): up to 40 years for open category, up to 45 years for backward category.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs 1,10,000 (consolidated, including all allowances) for Assistant Professor (Anatomy), Rs 1,10,000 (consolidated, including all allowances) for Assistant Professor (Physiology), Rs 1,10,000 (consolidated, including all allowances) for Assistant Professor (Biochemistry), Rs 1,10,000 (consolidated, including all allowances) for Assistant Professor (Pharmacology), Rs 1,10,000 (consolidated, including all allowances) for Assistant Professor (Pathology).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor: postgraduate degree (MD/MS/DNB) from a recognised university plus one year of experience as Senior Resident (mandatory); teaching experience preferred. Statistician cum Assistant Professor: postgraduate degree from a recognised university (M.Sc. (Statistics) with Ph.D. (Statistics)). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Affidavit not to leave service before the end of at least one academic session must be given before appointment.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who attach a recommendation letter or are recommended through other means will be disqualified. Applicants who put direct or indirect pressure on the selection committee will be excluded from the selection process.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Interview schedule will be communicated separately. Posts will be filled as per reservation.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract for 364 days or until a regular candidate is available, whichever is earlier. Commissioner may change the posting of the contract candidate when a regular candidate becomes available. Appointment may end without notice for unsatisfactory work, serious irregularity or misconduct.
